I had to bump C compiler but I have not updated CI to reflect it. I plan to revert to use same dependencies as upstream. but the dockerfile build still works fine if you run locally (CI tries to inject some additional arguments that are not valid with the updated c compiler) I just updated rust to 1.91 , which would still work with upstream I don't know if we should deviate even this much tho as new deps might cause other issues. I think better we dont okay I'll revert back then Can we update upstream c dep to something newer? I'm not sure. We would have to ask lighthouse maintainers what c version do you need? I'm not sure of the specific version but in the dockerfile this was the fix to get things compiling (in addition to removing compiler flags which are not supported by these newer versions):
```
RUN apt-get update && apt-get -y upgrade && apt-get install -y cmake libclang-dev clang
ENV CC=clang
ENV CXX=clang++
```
